Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.5 "To Roll the Stars in Astropolis" Special Program
The Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.5 "To Roll the Stars in Astropolis" Special Program will release on 2026/08/14 at 19:30 (UTC+8).

This program will be broadcast from the official livestream studio in Astropolis. This summer version will bring you a Trailblaze Continuance taking place shortly — or perhaps a long time — after the conclusion of our journey in Planarcadia. Let's enjoy a refreshing summer vacation with Robin • Summeretto and Aventurine • Waveflair!
Information regarding the Version 4.5 Trailblaze Mission will ░░░ be ░░░░░ in this ░░░ livestream.
